chunks: Al-Abbas ibn Hilal narrated from Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him) - from his father (peace be upon him) who said:

"No one ever said when he wanted to sleep: 'Indeed, Allah holds the heavens and the earth from ceasing; and if they should cease, none could hold them after Him. Indeed, He is Forbearing, Forgiving.'" Then the house (of the Kaaba) fell upon him."

key_terms.إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَا: Indeed, Allah holds the heavens and the earth
key_terms.فَسَقَطَ عَلَيْهِ الْبَيْتُ: Then the house fell upon him

ai.seo_question: What is the specific supplication to recite before sleeping to invoke Allah's holding of the heavens and earth?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Rida (AS) emphasizes the spiritual efficacy of reciting the 'Verse of Holding' (Ayat al-Rams) from Surah Fatir before sleep, linking it to divine protection against calamity. The narrative of the house falling upon the one who omitted it serves as a powerful admonition in Shia tradition regarding the necessity of adhering to specific prophetic supplications for safeguarding the soul and home during the vulnerable state of rest.
